summary: You can ask Nora, from one place, to tell the group somewhere else — «tell the Signal lot we're starting» from Discord.
details: She names the platform, not a room: your group has one room on each, so «tell Signal» is enough.
What arrives always says who asked for it. She never passes a message on as though it were her own words.
She still answers you where you asked, telling you whether it went.
limitations: Only between rooms belonging to the same group. A room in a different group is not merely refused — it cannot be reached or named from outside it.
Only for people who are themselves in both rooms. Being in one does not let you speak into the other.
One direction at a time — this is passing a message along, not linking the two rooms together, and nothing is mirrored automatically.
